name: Cambria
steps: Check that real-money gaming is legal where you live. We couldn't read Cambria's terms (see below).
Create an account in the Cambria lobby (referral link) with a wallet, email or social login.
Buy keys with USDC and play Dungeons runs to earn Royal Favor. Warning This is wagering with real money. Once keys are risked on a run, you can get back less than you put in.
Watch Cambria's blog and X account for the token and Genesis dates.
what: Cambria, a browser MMO with real-money stakes, has confirmed an $RSGP token. How Royal Favor points work, what a run costs, and the wagering risks.
behind: Cambria says it has raised $4.5 million from BITKRAFT, 1kx and angel investors, including a $2 million round in October 2025 from BITKRAFT and Sky Mavis, the Axie Infinity studio. A Cambria Foundation, formed in September 2026, will steward the protocol and token, BlockchainGamerBiz reported. costs: Earning points means risking money. A key costs $0.10 in USDC, and a run can currently risk up to 50 keys, about $5. Unrisked keys can be swapped back for USDC at face value. Cambria's Dungeons economics docs page on 18 October 2026, with the flow from a USDC deposit to keys, runs, Dungeon Coins and a weekly redemption. Source: Cambria docs
risks: This is wagering. BlockchainGamerBiz reported that 87% of the $41 million wagered in the Genesis event went through Dungeon Fishing, a mode it calls gambling-heavy. The terms of service link in Cambria's docs redirects to the lobby, so we couldn't check its age limit or excluded countries.
